අංක 1984/28 - 2016 සැȗතැȼබර් මස 15 වැǧ ȯහස්පƯǦදා - 2016.09.15 No. 1984/28 – THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 15, 2016

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: MCUDP/LA/MUT (W-14)/14/02/A. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2014/LRB/331. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the lands for the construction of a tunnel to create a drainage way from the main canal in Aluth Mawatha area up to the sea, under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project. Description of the land to be acquired: Four (04) allotments of lands described in following names and extents and total extent of 0.1746 hectare, depicted as lot No. 31, 32, 34 and 35 in the Preliminary Plan No. Co. 9653 dated 18.08.2016 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the village called Muthuwal in the Grama Niladhari Division of Lunu Pokuna, Aluth Mawatha in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Colombo in Colombo District of the Western province and more fully described as follows. 1. Lot No. 31 Name of the Land: Could not be traced; Description: Home Garden; Claimant: Could not be traced; Extent: 0.0557 Hectare. 2. Lot No. 32 Name of the Land: Land bearing assessment No. 57/1 at De La salle Street; Description: Home Garden; Claimant: Jayatissa Basnayake, No. 57/1, at De La salle Stree, Colombo 15; Extent: 0.0395 Hectare.

3. Lot No. 34 Name of the Land: Land bearing assessment No. 30 at De La salle Street; Description: Church; Claimant: Rev. Father Dencil Perera, Land bearing assessment No. 30 at De La salle Street, Colombo 15; Extent: 0.0336 Hectare. 4. Lot No. 35 Name of the Land: —; Description: Sea; Claimant: Department of Coastal Conservation; Extent: 0.0458 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Land Acquisition Office located in the Head Office of the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development corporation, No. 03. Sri Jayawardanapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya on 25th October, 2016 at 9.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th October, 2016, the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. C. W. ABEYSURIYA, Acquiring Officer, Metro Colombo Urban Development Project. Metro Colombo Urban Development Project, Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, No. 03, Sri Jayawardhanapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya 13th September, 2016.
